title: Microlabeler Sidecar — cleanup heuristics & micro-protocols
content:
Purpose: quick reference for microlabelers who ride shotgun on noisy batches. Not a formal guideline — intentionally short, actionable, and oriented to adjudication speed.

Context/why: We keep seeing recurring tiny failure modes that slow adjudication (5–10% of queue) — weird headers, embedded receipts, multilingual fragments, merged tokens. This doc collects fast heuristics + example pairs to reduce back-and-forth. Keep it on your editor tab during triage.

Principles (tl;dr):
- Prefer consistency over perfect edge-case parsing. If two reasonable choices, pick the one that matches the majority in the sample set.
- Minimal edits: annotate rather than rewrite when unclear. Add short rationale in the comment field (1–2 words).
- If label impacts model behavior (safety/PII) prefer conservative / abstain and flag for review.

Quick heuristics (one-liners):
- Email headers inside bodies: when a line looks like 'From: Name <a@b.com>' treat as metadata; label as metadata.header and do NOT mark as content.email_text. If header appears mid-message and is clearly quoted, drop it.
- Receipts / invoices: if numeric total + 'Subtotal' or 'Total' present, label as financial.receipt. Try to capture date and currency if available. If ambiguous, tag both financial.receipt and metadata.date.
- Phone numbers with extensions: prefer E.164 if country can be inferred from content. If not, keep as raw and mark as contact.phone.
- Abbreviations that look like product SKUs (e.g., PBX-12-AC): treat as code/sku, not as entity.product-name.
- Slashed tokens (foo/bar): prefer splitting into two tokens when both sides are alphanumeric; if one side is punctuation-only, attach to main token.
- Unicode confusables (smart quotes, en-dash vs hyphen): normalize to ASCII hyphen for matching but keep original in raw_text field.

Examples (label -> decision rationale):
1) "Invoice 2024-03-05 — Total: $23.50" -> financial.receipt (date + total present). Rationale: model downstream extracts transactions.
2) "From: payroll@company.com\nPlease confirm..." -> metadata.header + content.email_text (body after header). Reason: header is structured.
3) "Order ref: ORD/00012-zz" -> sku/code. Do NOT split on '/'. Rationale: order refs are atomic.
4) "Call me at (555) 111-2222 x333" -> contact.phone with extension tokenized as ext:333. Rationale: keeps ability to route.

Ambiguities and fall-throughs (protocols to reduce pinging):
- If message contains both a receipt and an email thread (e.g., forwarded receipt), label both financial.receipt and content.email_text; add short comment: 'fwd-receipt'. No need to escalate.
- If PII suspected in free text but not structured (e.g., 'my SSN is partially 123-**'), mark as pii.suspected and route to senior reviewer if downstream impact > threshold (see linked artifacts). Otherwise tag and redact during export.
- Multi-lingual short fragments: label language code if >60% tokens match a language profile, else label multilingual.fragment and attach samples to the batch for review.

Micro-adjudication shortcuts (use these in the tool's comment field):
- 'keep-majority' -> I deferred to dataset majority; no further action.
- 'abstain-safe' -> I abstained on safety/PII; escalate if >0.5% of a customer's data.
- 'merge-or-split' -> I merged/split tokens to match tokenizer; note tokenizer used (v3).

Tagging taxonomy gotchas (common mistakes):
- "name.title" vs "name.prefix": we use 'name.title' for salutations (Mr/Ms/Dr). 'name.prefix' reserved for organizational prefixes (Dept:, Team:). If unsure, choose name.title.
- 'address' vs 'location': address = postal formatted i.e., street/city/postcode; location = free-form place names (e.g., 'Bay Area').

Sample seeds for review batches (copy these into sampling tool):
- messages-with-multiple-dates-2025-Q4
- slashed-skewed-sku-samples
- unicode-hyphen-confusables

Open questions / TODOs:
- Decide canonical label for partial credit card mentions (masked vs last-4). Proposal: masked -> pii.masked-cc, last-4 -> pii.last4. Need sign-off from privacy. (owner: Zoe)
- Define threshold for "escalate to senior" when ambiguous safety label applied; current guess 0.5% of customer data processed. (owner: Evan)
- Add quick regex library to the sidecar UI for phone/date detection; current patterns live in JIRA-MLABEL-3421 but are scattered.

Actions (short):
- I will batch-scan last 2k items for unicode hyphen confusables and push a small dedupe + normalization script (ETA: 2026-03-07).
- Zoe to draft privacy note for masked card policy (ETA: 2026-03-10).
- Evan to propose escalation threshold by next triage (ETA: 2026-03-04).

Notes to self (short):
- Keep comments short (1–3 words) so tool UI doesn't truncate.
- Save frequent rationale strings in local quick-snippets: 'keep-majority', 'abstain-safe', 'merge-or-split', 'fwd-receipt'.

If you add new heuristics here, prefix with contributor initials and date, e.g., MP 2026-02-28: 'treat SMS-like short codes as promo.code if context contains coupon words.'

End.
